_note: Illustrative native live shapes. Read the current agent schema and text LLM catalog before sending a request. Provider model IDs and builtin voice IDs below reflect the current source contract; examples are not implicit defaults or deployment evidence.

prompt.prompt: 고객의 업무 문의를 짧고 정확하게 안내하세요.

voice_call_preflight.scope: agent-server source-code checks for single_prompt voice calls; not chat sessions

agent_schema.authority: authoritative for API request fields and accepted values

shared.data.llm: Keep the configured text/business LLM separate from runtime.model; do not invent chatLlm or an automatic chat fallback.

rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.reason: The configured screening response requires speech output.

rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.when: an operator target appears anywhere in the configured transfer_call setup, including mixed phone/SIP/operator destinations, regardless of the selected destination or transfer mode
rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.reason: The runtime cannot play the required operator-transfer announcement.

rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.when: enabled is true and messages contains at least one non-empty item
rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.reason: The configured scripted tool speech requires TTS.

rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.when: a warm transfer uses static announcement mode and the sentence is non-blank
rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.reason: The configured warm-transfer announcement requires TTS.

rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.when: a warm transfer uses dynamic announcement mode, even when the prompt is empty
rejected_for_gpt_live_and_gemini_live.reason: Dynamic mode still generates a warm-transfer whisper using its default instructions when the prompt is empty.

grok_voice.these_gpt_gemini_preflight_checks: not_applied; retains the current call path
grok_voice.boundary: This does not guarantee every TTS-dependent feature, call outcome, or voice quality.

voice_call_preflight.authoring_action: Do not silently remove or rewrite a requested setting to pass these checks. Surface the conflict and ask which setting or runtime the user wants to change.

contract_notes: GPT-Live, Grok Voice, and Gemini Live are supported only for type=single_prompt; Flow agents remain on pipeline without implicit conversion or migration.
On create, a missing runtime and runtime.type=pipeline preserve existing pipeline behavior; on update, an omitted runtime preserves the current mode.
Grok Voice requires grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 and Gemini Live requires gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025. Gemini 3.1 and 3.8 are outside this contract.

Every native runtime requires an explicit provider model and voice reference; GPT-Live uses model gpt-live-1 and accepts builtin or organization-authorized custom references, while Grok Voice and Gemini Live require builtin voices.
Use only the exact IDs in builtin_voice_catalogs. Grok IDs are lowercase; Gemini IDs are case-sensitive. Grok and Gemini reject custom voice objects.

A GPT-Live custom reference does not provision a voice or grant authorization; verify that the organization has approved and mapped the referenced voice. Existing pipeline voice settings are not migrated.
Native live input omits legacy stt, data.voice, parallelSTT, and speech preferences marked incompatible by the current schema; do not remove data.speech wholesale.
Keep data.llm as the selected text/business LLM, independent of runtime.model; do not infer or invent a chat fallback.
The pipeline-to-live update keeps existing data.llm unless explicitly changed. The live-to-pipeline update explicitly supplies stt and voice; it does not infer them from runtime.voice.
Native live reads may omit stt/voice or return them as null.

For all three native runtimes, effective data.speech.isAllowInterruption must be true. Create omission uses the true default; PATCH omission preserves the current value, so explicitly send true when switching from a stored false value. Agent-server rejects false and does not force it to true.
Existing pipeline voice settings remain unchanged and are not migrated.
Existing Flow node LLM overrides remain under flow.nodes[].data.llm as legacy Flow settings; they are not a native live feature and must not be rewritten to a native live model.
Voice-call preflight checks are agent-server source-code constraints, not API-schema validation or deployment evidence; do not silently drop unsupported fields.
